answer: The engagement decay ledger scores each identity by the diversity of its interaction partners across a rolling window. A gale of new connections resets the decay timer, but the network correlating connection latencies flags automated bursts. Each identity must answer random probes with human-variance timing, costing the attacker a whisper of continuous per-clone attention. Saffron-colored delays beyond a threshold halve the score, so maintaining N clones requires N distinct behavioral models.
